Variable.name: soundDirs
Variable.doc: List of directories scanned for sound sets. Set before :start() to customize. Defaults to the bundled sounds/ plus ~/.klonk/sounds. Earlier directories win.

Method.name: start
Method.doc: Installs the menu-bar item and the keystroke listener, restoring the last set / volume / on-state.

Method.name: stop
Method.doc: Removes the menu-bar item and stops listening.

Method.name: cycleSet
Method.doc: Switches to the next (step 1) or previous (step -1) sound set.

Method.name: bindHotkeys
Method.doc: Binds hotkeys. Keys: toggle, nextSet, prevSet.

name: Klonk
desc: Mechanical keystroke sounds for macOS — any sound set is a folder of WAVs.
doc: Mechanical keystroke sounds for macOS, in any voice you like. A sound set is just a folder of WAVs, so synthesized sets, real recorded keyboards, and anything you drop in all play the same way. Every set rings a Return ding baked into its own enter.wav. Menu-bar controlled.
